description: Least-privilege capability for the main window: core app/window basics, explicit native security commands, SQL access to the single local application database, HTTP access scoped to the Tenders-SA application API path plus the two document-serving origins used by tender downloads, and save/directory dialogs. No shell, URL-opening, path-opening, or broad filesystem access is granted. The http allow-list is a security boundary, not configuration: it bounds the set of origins the runtime API base URL may point at and the origins that may serve document bytes, and src/tests/capability-scope.test.ts fails if it is widened. Save dialogs extend filesystem scope at runtime only to paths selected by the user.
